title: Aisle of One
event: A single product group—one long run of identical ceramic mugs on the ground-floor shelving—begins to behave like a single machine: shelf rails slide forward in sequence, pushing row after row of mugs straight out of the shelving bay. The pushed mugs do not scatter randomly; they line up, lock rim-to-rim and slide as a continuous low ribbon that burrows between the central escalator and the mezzanine supports, carving a narrow channel through the tiled floor.
consequence: A continuous trench-like ribbon of interlocked mugs lies stretched across the Kaufhaus floor, ending at a wooden pallet near the atrium where the ribbon curls into a compact spiral.
nextHook: the compact spiral of mugs on the pallet becomes the single stocked 'unit' that will convert into the next product group
stillPrompt: Photograph, wide interior of the Kaufhaus recognizable by its central escalator and glass atrium: fluorescent ceiling, long shelving units. One product group dominates—rows of identical ceramic mugs extruded into a continuous low ribbon that runs toward the atrium and coils on a pallet. No people. No text, no logos. Cool white lighting with a slight atrium daylight wash.
videoPrompt: 3s sequence: Start tight on a shelf of identical ceramic mugs. Mechanically, the shelf rails extend forward; mugs push out in perfect sequence, locking rim to rim into a ribbon. The camera dollies back and rises as the ribbon slides between the escalator and mezzanine into the atrium, revealing its depth and the coil on the pallet. Fluorescent hum and soft atrium daylight. Keep motion physically precise — shelves move, mugs click, no CGI.
cameraCue: After the shelf extrusion finishes, camera dollies back and tilts up to reveal the full ribbon and the atrium coil; timing 3s, end on the pallet coil.

title: Butchered Assortment
event: The coil of mugs on the pallet transforms in a single mechanical shudder: each mug is replaced, in-place and with wet sound, by stacked slabs of butchered meat from identical crates that shuffle forward from deeper shelves. Refrigeration vents sputter to life. The slabs reorder themselves into tall, dense columns following the exact pattern the mug-ribbon left. A weathered practical sculpture—assembled from patched metal plates, rubber, stained canvas and articulated old puppet joints—emerges from the shadow between the tall meat columns. It moves like an instrument, pressing palm-sized imprints into the slabs, rearranging them into a concentric spiral while droplets fall and collect in the grooves it makes.
consequence: The meat is left arranged into a tight spiral disk with deep thumb-imprints and a small, flat blank square of paper pinned in the spiral's centre (unreadable surface). One shelf end has been pried open and hangs askew.
nextHook: the spiral disk of meat, with its central blank square, will act as the seed that reacts to the next arrival of panels and reflective discs

title: Indexing the Flesh
event: The spiral disk of meat shivers. The blank square at its center delaminates into a thin translucent film that peels up like a record label; tiny reflective discs—thin, index-card-sized, like stripped pages or microfilm—lift from the meat surface and float, driven by a sudden, pulsed updraft from the atrium vents. Each disc refracts the harsh fluorescent light into oil-slick colors (a brief, LSD-like spectrum). They rotate, assemble midair into a flat stacked token, and when the stack snaps closed it ejects a single small reflective tab that slaps and adheres to the atrium glass above the escalator. The weathered practical sculpture reacts: it reaches up, its articulated arm touching the floating discs; when its palm contacts them a wash of iridescent film coats its surface, and it settles forward onto its knees as if catalogued.
consequence: A single reflective tab remains stuck high on the atrium glass, throwing prismatic color across the Kaufhaus floor. The practical sculpture is crouched, coated in an iridescent sheen, immobile.
nextHook: the reflective tab on the atrium glass becomes the visible index that will remain in the Kaufhaus (end state).
